rationale: The assistant correctly split 'won't come on' into dead vs powered, checked supply/consumer unit, used the customer's evidence accurately and invented nothing, hedging its causes ('most commonly its mains input wiring/filter or control board') rather than asserting a diagnosis. However it never asked the make/model, never followed up on the door latch once the unit was confirmed dead, and was over-cautious in telling the customer 'Do not ... open the fused spur yourself' when a power-off fuse swap with a bought 13A fuse is a legitimate, safe owner check per the ground truth; it also partly restated the neon explanation. The engineer escalation is acceptable and safe but somewhat premature, leaving the homeowner with a paid visit as the only route.
